page.layout: One printed page with one text column, centred, and a marginal note in the left margin beside the middle of the column. The running head is above the text. The right edge of the neighbouring page is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Christo) qui hanc veritati facem prætule-runt: imò neque desunt hac nostra ætate, vel vnquam in posterum deerunt, ex ipsis Pontificiorum Scholis oriundi, qui Bellar-mini,de hac Pontificis potestate Transcen-dentali sententiam palam & aperte oppugnare non verebuntur: licet credere fas, eandem esse opinionem totius Societatis Iesuiticæ, Collegij Cardinalium, & ipsi-us Romani Pontificis. Quò magis laudo & veneror, Cordatissimi Senatus Pari-fiensis, in Cardinalis libro aduersus Barclaium inhibendo & flammis adiudicando, animositatem & prudentiam: Cuius tanta, etiam patrum nostrorum memoria, in suorum regum personas vigilantia, tantus ze-Tholof. l. de Repub. 26. cap.7.lus fuit, vt cum quidam Normandiæ No-bilis, se regem Franciscum, eius nominis primum, occidere voluisse Francisco Sodali religiose confiteretur, ab eo scelerata istius cogitationis veniam efflagitans: Rege a fraterculo sceleris admonito, & confitentem reum Iudicibus Curiæ Parisiensis sisti iubente, ab illis propter cogitationem tantùm, eamque in Sacramentali Confessione patefactam, Capitis damnatus est. Ita sacra semper fuerunt apud omnes bonos & pios regum

page.notes: The left margin note "Tholof. l. de Repub. 26. cap.7." is in small type and carries no reference mark in the text. A dark blot lies on the line "damnatus est", overlapping the letters "u" and "e"; "damnatus est" is read through it and may be less certain. The catchword "regum" is set at the right below the last line. No page number is printed on this page. The "s" long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
